subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
An audio amplifier is designed to have a small signal 
bandwidth of 20 kHz. The open loop low-frequency 
voltage gain of the op-amp is 105 and unit gain 
bandwidth is 1 MHz. What is the maximum closed-
loop voltage gain for this amplifier? 
 
(a) 500 
(b) 5 × 106 
 
(c) 2 × 106 
(d) 50
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-05 (EC/EE/IN).
